subject: Proposal II for Google Summer Code 2013 with R

messages.author: 4ff71d47ebc3c595
messages.subject: Proposal II for Google Summer Code 2013 with R
parts:
Hello!

This is my second proposal for Gsoc 2013: “Building a user friendly interface for data entry”. R has been created by Statisticians for Statisticians so I’m wondering if they (especially for those who work in National Institute of Statistics) could run their analysis with their favorite software (I mean R!)  immediately after completion of data entry without  being dependent of old-fashioned software like CSPRO?


HR,
